asserts: A recorder that declares a capability false is read as HAVING SAID SO. `info` prints the declaration itself (recorder, lang, every capability), and for each missing bookkeeping key it prints why the record is absent -- as a declaration, never as 'predates' (which is only true of a trace with no capabilities key at all) and never as a zero.

questions.ask: Does `info` print who recorded this trace, in what language, and what that recorder declared it produces?
With no threads_started and no children/spawn_syscalls/audit_errors in the trace, how does `info` explain the absence?
expect_contains: not recorded in this trace: threads_started
absence of the record is not a record of absence
